text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
Wants(x, y) ::: x wants to y.
Can(x, y) ::: x can y.
Access(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
Premises:
Likes(george, music) → Wants(george, compose) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
Access(george, program) → Can(george, compose) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
(Can(george, compose) ∧ Wants(george, compose)) → compose(george) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
(Likes(george, music) ∧ Access(george, program)) → compose(george) ::: If George likes music and has access to a program, he will compose.
